text: Klamath East: Bootleg Fire scar (99.83 ha cell, 99.56 ha of baseline forest) in Klamath East (ACR273). Latest clear Sentinel-2 view: 2026-10-10, showing a suspected reversal. Confirmed loss since the baseline: 98.8 ha (99.2% of the cell's forest). The reversal threshold was first crossed on 2021-08-07. 146 clear looks since 2019-06-09 are anchored on-chain. Against the independent Hansen Global Forest Change map (loss 2019-2024), CanopyProof found 99.9% of Hansen's loss pixels, and 99.6% of its own confirmed pixels agree.
disclaimer: Satellite change detection is evidence for review, not proof of carbon loss. It does not assess additionality, baselines or leakage, and a 1 km cell samples a project rather than measuring it.

documented_events: The Bootleg Fire burned through nearly 100,000 acres of the project.
Wildfire losses put live carbon below baseline, triggering termination and retirement of at least 1.14 million credits from California's buffer pool.
The owner sought to re-list 87% of the same land as four new projects (ACR1025-ACR1028).
